answer: Each submission hangs on the plume of a task receipt, and the summit is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the opal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
